title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. Activities and the objective include, rehabilitate community WASH infrastructure, conduct hygiene promotion and support the most vulnerable households with cash assistance. So, the most vulnerable are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, of high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat, Adigrat Diocesan Catholic Secretariat – Mekelle, Association of Pastoralist community for change and Daughter of Charity-Tigray ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
